raw.champion: Leukemia with leukemic meningitis and radiculopathy
raw.rationale: The presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions (leukemia cutis), severe flaccid quadriparesis, reduced muscle stretch reflexes, and cerebrospinal fluid analysis showing 98% atypical cells/blasts strongly support leukemia with CNS involvement, specifically leukemic meningitis and radiculopathy, as evidenced by the nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots on MRI spine.

rejected.label: Lymphoma with central nervous system involvement
rejected.why: While lymphoma can involve the CNS, the specific findings of leukemia cutis, the high percentage of atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid, and the pattern of nerve root involvement are more characteristic of leukemia.
